heading.purpose: Card titles, masthead title, section labels.

numeric.purpose: Non-primary numeric text not rendered as a seven-segment digit (percentages, coverage, timestamps).

shadows.name: floating-overlay
shadows.purpose: Alerts popup and InfoTip tooltip only -- the only elements genuinely overlaying document flow.

motion.name: segment-transition
motion.purpose: Seven-segment lit/ghost state changes, so a freshness flip reads as an instrument event rather than a snap.

components.name: Seven-Segment Readout
components.description: Signature numeric display: SVG seven-segment digits inside a near-black instrument casing, ghost (unlit) segments for missing/stale values.
components.css: .ds-instrument { display: inline-flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 4px; background: #05070a; border: 1px solid #1e293b; border-radius: 4px; padding: 12px 16px; } .ds-digit { width: 40px; height: 70px; } .ds-seg { transition: fill 0.5s ease-out; } .ds-seg-lit { fill: #5eead4; } .ds-seg-ghost { fill: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); }

components.name: Status Light
components.description: Small lit dot preceding a card or section title, marking category/liveness. Replaces a removed colored top-border card-accent convention.
components.css: .ds-card-title { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #0f172a; } .ds-status-light { display: inline-block; height: 8px; width: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: currentColor; color: #0d9488; margin-right: 8px; }

components.name: Status Tag
components.description: Flat outlined classification label, not a soft-filled pill. Tone color shared by border and text.
components.css: .ds-status-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 2px; border: 1px solid; padding: 2px 6px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-status-tag--emerald { border-color: rgba(5,150,105,0.5); color: #047857; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flush bordered panel, no drop shadow; hover shifts border color one step.
components.css: .ds-card { border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; background: #f8fafc; padding: 24px; transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #cbd5e1; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Theme toggle and similar icon-only controls: bordered, transparent, hover shifts to brand accent.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-btn" aria-label="Toggle dark mode"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4"/><path d="M12 2v2M12 20v2M4.93 4.93l1.41 1.41M17.66 17.66l1.41 1.41M2 12h2M20 12h2M6.34 17.66l-1.41 1.41M19.07 4.93l-1.41 1.41"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; width: 32px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; background: transparent; color: #475569; transition: color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-icon-btn:hover { border-color: #2dd4bf; color: #0f766e; } .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #2dd4bf; }

narrative.overview: The dashboard reads as an institutional research desk's instrument panel, not a consumer SaaS product. It carries forward the prior system's ledger discipline (flush bordered surfaces, one brand accent, status colors that never double as decoration) and adds its defining device this pass: every headline number is a real seven-segment instrument readout, built from actual SVG segment geometry (components/SevenSegmentValue.tsx), not a webfont imitation. When a value is missing or stale, the digit cell doesn't disappear or fall back to a dash string -- it renders as a fully-formed digit position with every segment in its dim, unlit "ghost" state, so data completeness is legible at the segment level, the same way an idle LED clock still shows all its dark segments. This pass also removed the prior system's colored top-border card accent (a known AI-generated-UI tell) and replaced it with StatusLight -- a small bg-current dot beside a card's own title. The instrument casing itself does not theme-switch; a physical LED readout doesn't have a light mode.
keyCharacteristics: Every headline and supporting number renders as a real seven-segment digit display, never a webfont or plain text numeral.
Missing/stale data is a visibly unlit ghost segment, never a blank string or omitted markup.
Category/section membership is marked by a small lit dot (StatusLight), never a colored top-border stripe.
The instrument casing (readout background) stays near-black regardless of page theme; only the page chrome around it switches.
One brand accent (teal), never reused for status meaning; status colors (emerald/red/amber) never reused as brand/structural color.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Teal is the only non-functional color on the page. If a new element needs emphasis and it isn't conveying bullish/bearish/warning/neutral, it gets teal or it gets nothing.

rules.name: The Ghost-Segment Rule
rules.body: A missing or stale numeric value never renders as "--", an empty string, or omitted markup -- it renders the full digit-cell template with every segment in its ghost (unlit) state.

rules.name: The Dot-Not-Stripe Rule
rules.body: Card/section category membership is marked by a StatusLight dot beside the title, never by a colored top-border or side-border stripe. The stripe convention was tried in the prior system and deliberately removed as a recognizable AI-UI tell.

rules.name: The Numbers-Are-Instrument Rule
rules.body: The primary numeric readouts render as seven-segment SVG digits, never as typeset text in any font. Secondary numeric text still uses JetBrains Mono, never IBM Plex Sans.

rules.name: The Flush-Not-Floating Rule
rules.body: An in-flow card never has a shadow or a top-border accent stripe. Category identity comes from the StatusLight dot; apparent elevation comes from a surface-color step, never box-shadow.

dos: Do render every primary numeric readout as a seven-segment SVG digit display, not typeset text.
Do render a missing/stale value as ghost (unlit) segments at the correct digit length, never as "--" or omitted markup.
Do mark card/section category with a StatusLight dot beside the title.
Do keep the instrument casing (bg-instrument) and card dark-mode surface (bg-instrument-surface) fixed regardless of theme toggle.
Do keep teal as the only decorative/structural accent color, and JetBrains Mono for any secondary numeric text not rendered as a segment display.
donts: Don't add a drop shadow to an in-flow card.

Don't add a colored top-border or side-border accent stripe to a card -- use StatusLight instead. (This is a defect the prior build carried and this redesign corrected; it is recorded here as removed, not as a device to reintroduce.)
Don't introduce a second brand accent hue alongside teal, or reuse a status color (emerald/red/amber) as a structural/brand color.
Don't round a status tag past rounded-sm, or fall back to a webfont/text numeral for a primary readout where a seven-segment display is expected.
